svg.title: Data model
svg.desc: Tables and their relationships: profiles, classes, rates, enrollments, invoices, lessons, logbooks, logbook entries and earnings.

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key

svg.text: Derived, not stored: hour_ledger and enrollment_balances (purchases minus delivered lessons).
tutor_id on lessons and earnings also points to profiles (not drawn). Student and tutor rates live in separate tables so each role sees only its own.
